items.name: Blur In
items.description: Starts blurred along a line and sharpens (CapCut "Blur"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Blur Out
items.description: Blurs along a line as it leaves (CapCut "Blur"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Zoom Blur In
items.description: Starts zoomed in and radially blurred, then settles (CapCut "Zoom Blur"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Zoom Blur Out
items.description: Zooms in with a radial blur as it leaves (CapCut "Zoom Blur"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Wipe In
items.description: Uncovered by a soft edge moving to the right (CapCut "Wipe"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Wipe Out
items.description: Covered again by a soft edge moving to the right (CapCut "Wipe"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Clock Wipe In
items.description: Uncovered by a hand sweeping clockwise from twelve (CapCut "Clock Wipe"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Clock Wipe Out
items.description: Covered by a hand sweeping clockwise from twelve (CapCut "Clock Wipe"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Slide In
items.description: Slides across the frame with motion blur and settles (CapCut "Slide"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.

items.name: Slide Out
items.description: Slides across the frame with motion blur as it leaves (CapCut "Slide"). Recreated and optimized with reference to CapCut's resources.
